messages:
Sam (Acme Corp): hey team, sending this here since our search is degraded after the model upgrade this morning. we index embeddings and now queries return empty/top-1 wrong answers. no obvious error in our app logs but vector store rejects inserts with a dim error.
Ava (Support): hey Sam — can you paste the exact error from the indexer / the API response? and which model id you upgraded to?
Sam (Acme Corp): indexer log: `error: embedding dim mismatch: expected 1536, got 768`
Sam (Acme Corp): we were on `embedder-v2` (1536) and the tenant auto-upgraded to `embedder-v3` (768) when the pinned alias rolled. we pinned to "latest" on purpose for perf but didn't expect a dim change.
Priya (ML Eng): oof. that explains it. embedder-v3 changed architecture + quantization resulting in 768 vectors. fingerprinted models should keep dims but this one was a breaking change. Sam — can you share the request body you used to generate embeddings?
Sam (Acme Corp): curl:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-ACME" \
  -d '{"model":"embedder-v3","input":["doc text..."]}'
```
Sam (Acme Corp): our index currently expects 1536, we tried to upsert and the vector store returned 400: "vector dimension mismatch"
Ava (Support): thanks. internal note: customer pinned to alias `latest` via Dedicated config — that alias now points at v3. Priority P1 since production search impacted. assigning to Priya + Jordan.
Jordan (SRE): quick mitigation options: 1) rollback alias to v2 for Acme tenant (if dedicated) — immediate; 2) re-run embedding job with new model to reindex docs (longer); 3) projection sham (down/up-sample) but that risks quality. which do you prefer Sam?
Sam (Acme Corp): rollback preferred; we can't afford reindex this AM. how fast is rollback?
Maya (Platform): if they're on Dedicated we can pin tenant alias to v2 in ~15-30m and safeguard other customers. if Hosted, we'd need org-scoped alias change — will coordinate. Sam: can you confirm you are on Dedicated?
Sam (Acme Corp): yes Dedicated, region us-west-2, cluster: acme-prod-1
Priya (ML Eng): I'll validate model artifact backwards compatibility and check if we should have incremented major version. also will add server-side dim-check warnings on upgrade in rollout pipeline.
deploy-bot: scheduled deploy rollback for acme-prod-1: revert alias latest -> embedder-v2, eta 00:22:30
Ava (Support): action: doing rollback now. I updated ticket SUPPORT-1256 and flagged for postmortem. Sam — I'll DM when completed.
Sam (Acme Corp): thanks :pray: 
(22m later)
deploy-bot: rollback complete for acme-prod-1. alias latest -> embedder-v2.
Sam (Acme Corp): confirmed! indexer accepted upserts again. queries look back to normal. huge thanks.
Priya (ML Eng): root cause: model v3 changed embedding dimensionality without a breaking-version major bump. release notes did not clearly call out the dim change for pinned/alias consumers.
Priya (ML Eng): follow-ups: 1) create an automated compatibility check in the model rollout pipeline that fails alias reassignment if dims change for existing alias consumers; 2) add a deprecation notice & migration guide for dimensionality changes in release notes; 3) provide a migration utility to re-embed in batches and a small warning on the API when client alias dims differ from index dims.
Jordan (SRE): also adding a quick guard in the Dedicated control plane to prevent silent alias flips for tenants with pinned alias and existing indexes.
Ava (Support): Sam — for next steps do you want a timeline for re-embedding with v3 (if you want to move later) or prefer to stay on v2?
Sam (Acme Corp): prefer to stay on v2 for now. please let us know before any future model alias changes. can you add an automated email/alert?
Maya (Platform): yes — we will add a tenant-scoped upgrade notification tied to alias changes. dev plan: warn 7 days ahead + a forced-change confirmation for dims changes.
Priya (ML Eng): added task ML-324: "alias-dim-compatibility-check". ETA for pipeline validation: 2 weeks.
Ava (Support): closing loop: SUPPORT-1256 -> resolved (rollback). will keep ticket open for follow-ups (reindex guidance + notification). tagging postmortem. :memo:
Sam (Acme Corp): appreciate the fast turnaround. please share notes on how to safely migrate to v3 later.
Priya (ML Eng): will prepare a migration doc with sample reindex script and cost estimate. rough approach: incremental re-embed by shard, verify recall, then swap alias during low-traffic window.
Sam (Acme Corp): perfect. thanks everyone :thumbsup:
Ava (Support): marking as resolved for outage. follow-up items tracked in SUPPORT-1256 and ML-324.
